nodes.label: HTTP Status Codes
nodes.rationale: Distinguish 4xx (client/request) from 5xx (server failure) to direct debugging.

nodes.rationale: Destination IP must stay readable for delivery; SNI/DNS exposure depends on encrypted DNS and ECH.

nodes.label: HTML Global Attributes (id, class, data-*)
nodes.rationale: Style with class, select single element in JS with id; id styling raises specificity.

nodes.label: HTML Form and Input Validation
nodes.rationale: HTML validation is convenience only; server-side validation is mandatory.

nodes.label: label for/id Association
nodes.rationale: Needed for screen-reader accessibility and click usability.

nodes.label: button type Default submit Pitfall
nodes.rationale: Untyped buttons inside forms submit and reload the page; declare type=button.

nodes.label: Semantic HTML Tags
nodes.rationale: Improves readability, accessibility and SEO; article vs section decided by whether it stands alone.

nodes.label: Data Lifecycle (requirements to operations)
nodes.rationale: Good SQL is limited by bad schema and a good DB is untrustworthy without operations and recovery planning.

nodes.label: DBeaver
nodes.rationale: DBeaver is a client, not a DB; separating roles helps classify connection vs SQL vs server errors.

nodes.label: Database Evolution (File, Hierarchical, RDBMS, NoSQL, Cloud)
nodes.rationale: Evolution is about balancing consistency, scalability and availability; NoSQL is an alternative, not a successor.

nodes.label: ACID
nodes.rationale: ACID consistency means invariants hold, distinct from distributed replica consistency.

nodes.label: WAL (Write-Ahead Logging)
nodes.rationale: Sequential log write reduces commit latency; redo replays committed WAL for recovery.

nodes.label: Transaction Isolation Levels
nodes.rationale: Higher isolation increases waits/conflicts; choose per business consistency and throughput.

nodes.label: Foreign Key and Referential Integrity
nodes.rationale: CASCADE is convenient but hides delete scope; use only for clear ownership.

nodes.label: Key Types (Super, Candidate, Surrogate, Natural, Composite)
nodes.rationale: Surrogate keys are stable for joins but natural-key uniqueness must still be declared.

nodes.label: Normalization (1NF-BCNF)
nodes.rationale: Decide where each fact is stored once; aim for lossless decomposition and dependency preservation.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Schema and search_path
nodes.rationale: Explicit schema qualification avoids malicious same-name objects earlier in search_path.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Data Types (NUMERIC, TIMESTAMPTZ, JSONB)
nodes.rationale: NUMERIC avoids float errors for money; TIMESTAMPTZ normalizes instants to UTC.

DBMS vs Data Warehouse vs Data Mining
nodes.rationale: Analytical scans compete with OLTP; replicate via CDC/ETL to a warehouse at scale.

nodes.label: Aggregation and GROUP BY / HAVING
nodes.rationale: Check the row grain before aggregating; JOIN fan-out requires COUNT(DISTINCT).

nodes.label: ROLLUP / CUBE / GROUPING SETS
nodes.rationale: CUBE yields 2^n groupings; use GROUPING SETS when needed combinations are known.

nodes.label: JOIN Types (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, CROSS, SELF)
OUTER JOIN ON vs WHERE Placement
nodes.rationale: Right-table filter in WHERE turns LEFT JOIN into INNER JOIN semantics.

nodes.label: Semi Join / Anti Join (EXISTS / NOT EXISTS)
nodes.rationale: NOT IN with NULLs yields unexpected empty results; NOT EXISTS states intent.

nodes.label: Recursive CTE
nodes.rationale: visited_ids array prevents infinite recursion on cycles.

nodes.label: UPSERT (INSERT ON CONFLICT)
nodes.rationale: Separate check-then-insert has a race condition; atomic UPSERT uses unique constraint.

nodes.label: Keyset Pagination
nodes.rationale: Large OFFSET reads and discards rows; keyset seeks via index.

nodes.label: pgvector Hybrid Search (relational filter + vector similarity)
AI-generated SQL Validation Checklist
nodes.rationale: AI tools do not guarantee business meaning, row grain, permissions or cost.

nodes.label: Index Design by Query Pattern
nodes.rationale: Indexes cost storage and write speed; index only frequently used paths; equality columns before range/sort.

nodes.label: Denormalization
nodes.rationale: Document source of truth, update mechanism and reconciliation before storing derived values.

nodes.label: Sharding
nodes.rationale: Introduce only after measuring single node, read replica and partitioning limits.

nodes.label: Saga / CQRS / Outbox Patterns
nodes.rationale: Outbox avoids dual-write between DB commit and message send; consumers must be idempotent.
